title: Cost-Sensitive Online Window Size Selection for Portfolio Management
summary: This paper investigates cost-sensitive online window size selection for portfolio management under changing market conditions. Specifically, we propose a two-level framework that constructs portfolios using candidate window sizes and dynamically aggregates them through online learning. By treating candidate window sizes as ``experts,'' we dynamically update their aggregation weights using turnover-inclusive losses.
